_comment: Toolchain pin for the layout/ verification flow (klt drc / klt extract /
klt lvs), checked -- not merely recorded -- before any layout/ runner
does anything. This is a CAPABILITY list, not a version number: `klt
--version` reports klayout-tools' own static pyproject.toml version,
which can lag well behind what commands an install actually has.
`klt_required_commands` is the drift-detectable pin instead --
every layout/ runner should look each entry up in `klt --help`'s
subcommand list before doing anything else and fail loudly, naming
the missing command and the install command to fix it, rather than
skip the check silently. Keep ONE shared implementation (conventionally
`layout/toolchain_pin.py`) that every DRC/LVS/extraction runner
imports, rather than re-deriving this check per runner -- otherwise
the runners can drift apart on what they check.
THIS FILE IS A BOOTSTRAP STARTER: sg13cmos5l-protocol-emulator has not chosen a klt pin
yet, so klt_install / klt_last_verified_commit below are placeholders,
not a foreign repo's history. Fill them in with the exact commit you
verify `klt drc` (and `extract` / `lvs`, once those runners exist)
against when this repo's layout/ harness first comes up (the standard
opening issue #2), and re-check klayout_package_min against
klayout-tools' current pyproject.toml floor at the same time. From
that point on, keep this comment APPEND-ONLY: record each later pin
bump as a new paragraph naming the issue, what changed upstream, and
why, rather than editing or deleting an earlier one. A correction to
an earlier paragraph gets its own new paragraph too -- never an edit
to the one it corrects -- so a later reader can see why the pin is
where it is without re-deriving it from git blame.
Field reference:
klt_install            exact commit to install `klt` from -- a
`pip`/`uv tool install` VCS URL pinned with
`@<sha>` (no PyPI release yet), never a
floating branch reference.
klt_required_commands  every `klt <command>` this repo's layout/
runners invoke. A missing one should be a
tooling error (exit 1) from any runner that
needs it, not a silently-skipped check.
Starts with just `drc` -- the first thing a
fresh layout/ harness wires up -- and grows
as `extract`/`lvs` runners are added.
klt_last_verified_commit  the exact commit klt_install resolves to,
restated here so it is visible without
parsing the install URL. Update both
together and re-run every runner's --check
when bumping.
klayout_package_min    floor for the pip `klayout` package version
(klayout-tools' own pyproject.toml pins a
floor of its own; recorded here so a drift
in *this* repo's pin is visible next to
klt's).

2026-09-12 (standup): pinned to klayout-tools main as of this repo's creation, the commit the scaffold was run against. It is a STARTING pin, not a verified one: no layout/ runner exists yet and klt's synthesize/par platform table does not yet carry an IHP CMOS5L entry, so `klt drc` against this PDK has not been exercised here. Issue #2 verifies the pin (or bumps it) when the first layout/ harness comes up, and records the result as a new paragraph below.

2026-09-14 (issue #2): bumped klt_install/klt_last_verified_commit from 051e8f7 to 5c757081680e207b6abbc7a6ca7d3688ad07072a (051e8f7 is an ancestor of this commit -- a forward move, not a rewrite), the exact commit `klt drc` was actually exercised against for this bump. `klt drc --deck sg13cmos5l --format json` against a trivial synthetic layout (a single shape on layer 1/0, no real design content -- issue #2 does not produce a GDS yet) ran end to end: `klt deck info` reports the `sg13cmos5l` deck as `released: true` (release 0.4.0), and the drc run itself returned `status: clean`, `violation_count: 0`, with a full provenance block (`klt_version`, `klayout_version`, `deck.content_hash`, `input.content_hash`). This verifies the `drc` command and the `sg13cmos5l` deck are both genuinely present and runnable at this pin -- not just that `klt --help` lists `drc` -- but it is still a smoke check, not a real-layout DRC pass: no actual standard-cell/GDS content has gone through this deck yet, since this repo has no layout/ content-producing flow yet (this issue only wires up the RTL->netlist harness, not place-and-route). A future layout/ runner (once one exists) should re-verify against real content and record that as its own new paragraph, not edit this one. klayout_package_min re-checked against klayout-tools' current pyproject.toml floor (`klayout>=0.30`) -- unchanged.

2026-09-21 (issue #20): bumped klt_install/klt_last_verified_commit from 5c757081680e to 1d964cf4ed93b15bd36acf1eb14e3855b3c500d1 (again a forward move, not a rewrite), and grew klt_required_commands from [drc] to [drc, sta]. Why: issue #20's `klt sta` corner-sweep leg cannot run against IHP liberty at the 5c757081680e-era tree -- `klt sta` (post_route_sta.py) there still carries its own byte-identical copy of the pre-#1861 liberty resolver, which hardcodes the SkyWater-style `<cell_library>__<corner>.lib` double-underscore filename and rejects IHP's single-underscore `<cell_library>_<corner>.lib` (the same klayout-tools#1786 gap, in the verb the #1786-era fix did not yet cover). klayout-tools#1861 (commit 2c39b7b3, 2026-09-15) wired post_route_sta's `_resolve_liberty` to the shared single-underscore-compatible `resolve_liberty_for_cell_library`; the new pin is 188 commits past that fix and 1 ahead of it in verified currency on upstream main. Verified live at 1d964cf4, all in issue #20's sweep-record run: (1) `klt sta` (verilog mode) resolves `sg13cmos5l_stdcell_<corner>.lib` for all six shipped corners and returns `timing_status: constrained` per corner over a freshly synthesized netlist (flow/run-sta-corner-sweep.sh end to end); (2) plain `klt synthesize flow/synthesize-protocol-emulator.json` drives the synthesis leg itself -- klayout-tools#1786's workaround (flow/run_synthesize_direct_yosys.py) is no longer needed at this pin, and is retained only for record history; (3) `klt deck info` resolves the sg13cmos5l deck (content_hash sha256:1912f174..., release fields now false/null -- upstream's own current state, not an install fault); (4) the trivial-layout DRC smoke re-verified: `klt drc --deck sg13cmos5l` on a fresh single-shape layer-1/0 layout returns `status: clean`, `violation_count: 0`; (5) `klt functional-verification verification/request-protocol-emulator.json` passes (cocotb 2.1.0), so the bumped pin does not break the existing verification harness. HOST CAVEAT, recorded because the provisioning route matters to reproducing the pin: on the host this verification ran on, three `uv tool install --force` invocations at the pinned URL (including one with `--no-cache`, whose verbose output showed a correct 1d964cf4 checkout and wheel build) did NOT update the user-level uv tool venv -- it kept serving the pre-bump tree (sta kept failing with the double-underscore error and site-packages lacked the new pdk_cells.py). The verified environment therefore ran from a wheel built at the pinned commit from a clean `git worktree add` of 1d964cf4, installed under this repo's gitignored `.venv/` (the local-install route docs/environment.md already anticipates); the runner honors a KLT_BIN override for exactly this. `uv tool install`'s silent stale-serve on this host is unreduced -- worth a fresh look before the next pin bump relies on scripts/setup-env.sh alone.

2026-09-22 (issue #21): pin UNCHANGED (still 1d964cf4ed93b15bd36acf1eb14e3855b3c500d1) -- this paragraph records a new command verified live at the existing pin, not a bump. Grew klt_required_commands from [drc, sta] to [drc, sta, place-and-route]. Why: issue #21's die-area leg needs `klt place-and-route` against `sg13cmos5l_stdcell` -- the first place-and-route run of this repo's flow against this PDK (its LEF/liberty resolution goes through the same single-underscore-compatible resolvers the 2026-09-21 paragraph already verified for sta/synthesize, plus `lef_files()`' corner-invariant `lef/sg13cmos5l_tech.lef` fallback for IHP's no-techlef/ install shape). Verified live at 1d964cf4, in issue #21's die-area record run (flow/run-die-area-par.sh end to end): (1) `klt synthesize` re-confirmed on both tops (11,603 cells / 312,062.8896 um^2 for rtl/protocol_program_memory.v, 16 cells / 537.0624 um^2 for the stub -- byte-identical to the numbers the 2026-09-21-era records already carry); (2) `klt place-and-route` (target_stage: place, floorplan method utilization 40%, site CoreSite, io Metal3/Metal2, clk 20 ns, seed 1) reached `stage_reached: place` for both tops through the docker-wrapped `openroad` (openroad/orfs:latest, engine 26Q3-2056-g41a28926b9), reporting die/core area and placed utilization; the `cts`/`route` stages were NOT exercised and are NOT claimed (sg13cmos5l_stdcell has no verified _CTS_BUFFER_CELLS/_ROUTING_LAYER_RANGE/_ANTENNA_DIODE_CELLS entries at this pin -- a klayout-tools follow-up, recorded in the die-area record, not worked around here). Provisioning route: same as the 2026-09-21 paragraph's caveat -- wheel built at the pinned commit from a clean `git worktree add`, installed under the gitignored `.venv/`, driven via KLT_BIN.

2026-09-27 (issue #49): bumped klt_install/klt_last_verified_commit from 1d964cf4ed93b15bd36acf1eb14e3855b3c500d1 to c622e8addb362491664d44ba4d717f354ca88bbd (v0.6.0; 1d964cf4 is an ancestor -- a forward move, not a rewrite), and grew klt_required_commands from [drc, sta, place-and-route] to [drc, sta, place-and-route, signoff]. Why: `klt signoff --check` (klayout-tools #2258, commit ae0ddcbb, 2026-09-21, filed in response to this repo's own friction-protocol issue #2249) re-grades a manifest and verifies a committed tier report still reproduces, EXCLUDING the report's build block -- exactly the route-independent comparison scripts/signoff-report.sh's --check-latest needs. The byte-compare it replaces failed between two legitimate installs of the SAME pinned commit purely on the clean/.dirty provisioning route (the 20260921-182522 -> 20260921-191106 supersession treadmill this repo already went through once), which left CI's signoff job unconditionally red on main (issue #49's Problem). Verified live at c622e8ad, all on this host with KLT_BIN pointing at wheels built from a clean `git worktree add` of the pin (both routes built: the clean-tree wheel reports 0.6.0 / dirty:false / is_release:true; a second wheel built with one tracked file modified reports 0.6.0+gc622e8addb36.dirty / dirty:true -- same git_commit, the exact route pair #2249 names): (1) `klt signoff --manifest ... --check <committed report>` -- match (exit 0) from BOTH route builds against the same committed record (the route-independence acceptance criterion), and drifted (exit 3, naming the field) against the pre-bump record's artifact exactly as the re-mint requires; (2) `klt signoff --manifest` render at the new pin grades every item identically to the 20260922-012257-3dbfdc5 record -- all 14 items byte-identical on status/reason/citation, t1_item_count 11 and t1_met_count 0 unchanged; the only additions are the excluded build block and one new top-level field build_t1_item_count (11), which is exactly the drift the re-mint record for this bump freezes; (3) drc re-confirmed: `klt drc --deck sg13cmos5l --format json` on a fresh single-shape layer-1/0 trivial layout returns status clean, violation_count 0; (4) sta re-confirmed: flow/run-sta-corner-sweep.sh typ_1p20V_25C (synthesize once + one corner) returns run_status ok / timing_status constrained with the single-underscore IHP liberty resolver working -- a single corner, not the six-corner sweep, which is NOT re-run at this bump; (5) place-and-route re-confirmed: flow/run-die-area-par.sh reached stage_reached: place for BOTH tops through the docker-wrapped openroad, with synthesis numbers byte-identical to the recorded history (11,603 cells / 312,062.8896 um^2 protocol_program_memory; 16 cells / 537.0624 um^2 stub) -- the cts/route stages remain unexercised, as at the previous pin. klayout_package_min re-checked at c622e8ad: pyproject floor still klayout>=0.30 (deliberately a floor, not a pin); note the verification wheels resolved klayout 0.30.12 while klt's uv.lock pins 0.30.10 -- klt warns on the mismatch (report-count-level only, verdict unaffected; CI's setup-env.sh uv-tool route resolves the floor the same way). HOST CAVEAT, unchanged from the 2026-09-21 paragraph: `uv tool install --force` stale-serve was again NOT relied on -- both verification wheels were built from clean git worktrees of the pin and installed into throwaway venvs driven via KLT_BIN; the stale-serve itself remains unreduced upstream.

2026-10-09 (issue #82): bumped klt_install/klt_last_verified_commit from c622e8addb362491664d44ba4d717f354ca88bbd to 6457a605d73e4fff6421e3fce6674a825a745d70 (c622e8ad is an ancestor -- a forward move, not a rewrite; klt --version reports 0.6.0+g6457a605d73e because upstream's pyproject.toml version has not moved). klt_required_commands is UNCHANGED (the drc/sta/place-and-route/signoff capability list is a superset check; extract and lvs, already exercised at the previous pin by the issue #65 record, are not added to it by this bump). Why: three upstream fixes the item-4 (LVS clean) evidence was blocked on: klayout-tools #2657 (b784dfe4, vector-macro port connections in the gate-level-verilog reference converter), #2656 (37406444, klt extract per-request label-purpose override: the `label_layers` request field, `--label-layer ROLE=LAYER/DATATYPE` on the CLI) and 6457a605 (the same override on klt lvs and klt pex). The `label_layers` field is used in flow/extract-librelane-gds.json only (metal0=8/25, metal1=10/25, metal2=30/25, metal3=50/25: the .text purposes the routed GDS carries its net names on); klt lvs takes the override only for inline extraction and this repo's LVS requests read the pre-extracted netlist, so they carry none. Side effect to know: the sg13cmos5l extraction deck content hash moved from sha256:1912f174 to sha256:db9f44fa between the two pins, so the T1 item 3 DRC citation was re-run at this pin (verification/records/librelane-gds-signoff-check/records/20261009-054750-676f8b2.md). Verified live in a throwaway venv built from a clean clone of the pin under /tmp; the shared dispatch worker's host-wide klt was NOT touched and scripts/setup-env.sh was NOT run there. Provision the pin elsewhere with ./scripts/setup-env.sh.
